title: Systems of Equations: Graphing, Substitution, Elimination | Algebra I, Unit 6 (with Worked Examples)
description:
Solve systems of linear equations by graphing, substitution and elimination, recognize systems with no solution or infinitely many, solve word problems with two unknowns, and graph systems of linear inequalities. After every lesson there's a step-by-step worked example with tips and a practice question, and the unit ends with a real-world "Putting it together" problem.
